"""Verify a maximal request end-to-end against the Python reference."""
import json, sys, os, time, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from ref import Fib, Image, Bad

src = open('/workspace/tmp/tests/maxtest.py').read().replace("\nif __name__ == '__main__':", "\nif False:")
g = {'__name__': 'bt', '__file__': '/workspace/tmp/tests/maxtest.py'}
exec(compile(src, 'maxtest', 'exec'), g)
req = g['build'](int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 3)
body = json.dumps(req, separators=(',', ':'))
print('request bytes', len(body))
t0 = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'run.py'], input=body.encode(), cwd='/workspace',
                   capture_output=True, timeout=600)
print('elapsed %.2fs' % (time.time() - t0))
resp = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
res = resp['results'][0]
fib = Fib()
exp = []
si = 0; li = 0; loaded = None
t0 = time.time()
for op in req['cases'][0]['ops']:
    if op[0] == 'put': fib.put(op[1], op[2], op[3])
    elif op[0] == 'query':
        for a in op[1]: exp.append(fib.lpm(a))
    elif op[0] == 'image_query':
        for a in op[1]: exp.append(loaded.lookup(a) if loaded else None)
    elif op[0] == 'save': si += 1
    elif op[0] == 'load_saved': loaded = Image(res['snapshots'][op[1]]); li += 1
print('reference took %.2fs' % (time.time() - t0))
bad = [(i, a, b) for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(exp, res['answers'])) if a != b]
print('mismatches', len(bad), bad[:5])
for img in res['snapshots']:
    Image(img)
print('loads', res['loads'])
print('MAXVERIFY', 'PASS' if not bad and all(res['loads']) else 'FAIL')
if bad or not all(res['loads']): raise SystemExit(1)
PY
cd /workspace && timeout 1800 python3 tmp/tests/maxverify.py 3
